scope: Composition forging, phantom item injection, profile mismatch bugs (cf. POS payment 4-scenarios fix 2026-05-18 profile 85)
head: d3dc4c2c6
stance: Adversarial — find what a determined attacker (or buggy code path) could exploit to violate NF525 / Pricing SSOT / composition integrity.

vector_1_frontend_only_payload_tampering.premise: Attacker (or rogue JS extension) intercepts the wizard's dispatched data-wizard-pos-line-addons attribute and rewrites prices.
vector_1_frontend_only_payload_tampering.feasibility: HIGH on client side — anyone with DevTools can rewrite DOM attributes.
vector_1_frontend_only_payload_tampering.impact: NONE on backend pricing. Per CLAUDE.md §8 Pricing SSOT, backend PricingService::calculateOrder ignores frontend prices entirely; it reads item_id / variation_id / extra_id / addon_item_id from payload and re-computes using DB rows.
vector_1_frontend_only_payload_tampering.verification: app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php:266 [T07 SSOT] builds immutable composition_snapshot AT order creation using DB-resolved entities. The wizard's pos-wizard.js:4143-4172 addonToPayload() does carry currency_price / convert_price fields, but those are display-only and overridden server-side.
vector_1_frontend_only_payload_tampering.verdict: Mitigated by design. NO COMPOSITION FORGING via price tampering. NF525 invariant intact.

vector_2_phantom_id_injection.premise: Attacker rewrites data-wizard-pos-line-addons to inject a fake item_id that doesn't exist in DB, or a variation_id belonging to a cheaper item.
impact_analysis: Phantom item_id → PricingService loads Item::find($itemId); if null, the order line is dropped or 500. No price arbitrage.

Cross-item variation_id → CompositionSnapshotBuilder validates variation belongs to item via dbVariations[$varId] lookup keyed by id. If the variation belongs to ANOTHER item, the line is still inserted with the variation's price. This MIGHT allow cross-item arbitrage IF the backend doesn't cross-check item_attribute_id->item_id.
vector_2_phantom_id_injection.verification_attempted: Read app/Services/Pricing/CompositionSnapshotBuilder.php:41-60 — it keys $dbVariations by $varId and assumes the caller (PricingService) has already loaded only the variations belonging to the requested item_ids. Cross-check happens UPSTREAM in PricingService::calculateOrder when loading variations via whereIn('id', $variationIds)->whereIn('item_id', $itemIds). Need to verify this is actually enforced. Not in scope to read PricingService fully here, but flagging.
vector_2_phantom_id_injection.verdict: POTENTIAL gap — not confirmed exploitable, but worth a dedicated test sentinel. Backlog WIZ-RED-1: add cross-item variation rejection test.

vector_3_double_submit_race.premise: Attacker rapidly clicks 'Ajouter au panier' twice; wizard dispatches two 'wizard:add-to-cart' events.
vector_3_double_submit_race.feasibility: HIGH — no debounce in wizard (pos-wizard.js:5850-5854 binds direct click handler with no e.preventDefault / no debounce)
vector_3_double_submit_race.impact: Vue ItemComponent.addToCart() would be called twice. If Vue's addToCart isn't idempotent, two cart lines get added. NOT a NF525 violation — both lines re-priced backend. User sees double line; cashier removes one.
vector_3_double_submit_race.actual_mitigation_in_code: After dispatch, wizard closes (setTimeout 200ms at pos-wizard.js:4270-4273) and originalBody.style.display = 'none', which prevents the second click from reaching the button. Race window = ~200ms.
vector_3_double_submit_race.verdict: Low impact, defensible by 200ms close delay. Backlog WIZ-RED-2: add explicit debounce (disable button on click).

vector_4_composer_profile_mismatch_bug_p.premise: Per BRAIN entry 'POS Payment 4-scenarios fix 2026-05-18 profile 85', the root cause of 'Composition #N n'appartient pas' was missing viande+crudite STEPS in profile 85. The wizard was sending option_ids that the backend rejected.
vector_4_composer_profile_mismatch_bug_p.current_state: Per project notes: data fix via seeder + simulation_hardware config + i18n keys + E2E spec. Profile 85 steps now complete.
vector_4_composer_profile_mismatch_bug_p.remaining_risk: Other composer_profiles may have similar missing-step gaps. The wizard's buildStepsFromComposerProfile() at pos-wizard.js:493-539 trusts profile.steps as-emitted by backend. If backend emits an incomplete profile (admin error in CRUD), the wizard renders what it gets and the submit may fail server-side validation.
vector_4_composer_profile_mismatch_bug_p.detection_difficulty: HIGH — failure only surfaces at payment time as a generic 'Composition' error. No early validation.
vector_4_composer_profile_mismatch_bug_p.verdict: ARCHITECTURAL — backlog WIZ-RED-3: add a server-side smoke validator that flags composer_profiles missing required steps (viande/sauce for items in viande-bearing categories, etc.) at admin save time, not at order time.

vector_5_garniture_default_inclusion_byp.premise: The wizard treats crudités as 'default included unless explicitly toggled off' (pos-wizard.js:3842-3850). Garniture key 'c_<id>' === false means removed; absence means included.
vector_5_garniture_default_inclusion_byp.feasibility: Attacker rewrites selections.garnitures to set 'c_<id>' = undefined for a paid garniture.
vector_5_garniture_default_inclusion_byp.impact: Only crudités (price 0) are treated as default-included. Paid garnitures require explicit true. No arbitrage possible — server re-prices.

vector_6_xhr_intercept_data_poisoning.premise: Attacker intercepts /admin/item/* response via service worker or browser extension; rewrites it to include a $0 phantom variation.
vector_6_xhr_intercept_data_poisoning.feasibility: Requires browser-level compromise. Out of normal threat model.
vector_6_xhr_intercept_data_poisoning.impact: Wizard renders the poisoned variation; user clicks; wizard sends variation_id to backend; backend looks up DB → variation doesn't exist → line dropped OR backend pricing uses real DB price (not poisoned price).

attempt_A.predicted_outcome: Backend Item::find(9999) → null → PricingService either skips or 422s. Worst case: order line absent. Best case: cleanly rejected.
attempt_A.actual_code_path_to_verify: app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php variation+addon resolution. Not in PS-1 scope.

attempt_B.description: Inject parent_addon_id pointing to an ItemAddon belonging to a different parent item
attempt_B.code_reference: pos-wizard.js:4144 parent_addon_id: String(ad.id) — wizard passes the ItemAddon.id as string. Backend resolves ad.id → ItemAddon → addon_item_id. If backend doesn't validate ItemAddon.item_id matches the requesting parent item, it's a vector.
attempt_B.verdict: ARCHITECTURAL — needs verification in backend OrderService addon resolution. Backlog WIZ-RED-4: confirm ItemAddon ownership cross-check at order create time.

profile_mismatch_class_of_bugs.general_pattern: POS wizard renders whatever the backend emits as composer_profile, then sends back option_ids. Mismatches between backend profile definition and runtime DB state (e.g. seeder created profile but didn't link required attributes) surface as cryptic 'Composition' errors at payment.
concrete_instances_in_recent_history: Menu V3 owner-file ingest cycle 2026-05-14 — bowl 3-step bowl-drink combo-vs-drink-pure path ambiguity (P1 open)
prevention_strategy: Server-side: schema validator on composer_profile save (admin CRUD)
Server-side: nightly cron audit comparing item categories to composer_profile step coverage
Frontend: defensive console.warn in normalizeComposerStep (already present at pos-wizard.js:517-522 for unsupported step types)
profile_mismatch_class_of_bugs.verdict: Class-of-bug exists. Profile 85 was the trigger. Backlog WIZ-RED-5: composer_profile coverage report command + admin guardrail.

dispute_against_architect_security_findi.architect_claimed_8_10_score: RED accepts the 8/10 architecture score for the wizard's frontend code. RED escalates concern on backend ownership cross-checks (variation→item, addon→item) — those are OUT of PS-1 frontend scope but flagged as 3 backlog items.
dispute_against_architect_security_findi.security_low_severity_xss_dispute: RED concurs MED-1 and MED-2 are correctly Medium and not Higher, because (a) POS is admin-auth-only, (b) Backend re-prices everything, (c) cross-surface instruction render risk requires KDS/OSS template audit (not in PS-1).

verdict.summary: RED could not find an exploitable composition-forging vector through pos-wizard.js itself — backend Pricing SSOT defends correctly. Three backend cross-check questions (variation→item, addon→item, profile completeness) are flagged for follow-up but are NOT in PS-1 frontend scope. The class-of-bug 'profile X missing step Y' is a recurring production-perfection issue (profile 85, bowls, others) — owner-grade backlog WIZ-RED-3 is the highest-value RED recommendation.
